content: The paper says Ibn Turka launched his writing career during a fifteen-year tenure in Mamluk Cairo (ca. 795-810/1393-1408), training in law, Arabic letters and occult science and making mortal enemies at court, most infamously Ibn Khaldūn (d. 808/1406); the very year of his enemy's death he published the Five Debates (Munāẓarāt-i khams).
